subject: Post-call: token volumes, $/1M target and continuous batching assumptions
messages:
From: Devon Lee <devon@brightcart.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T16:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro / demo follow-up

Camila — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying questions before we loop in procurement: 

- We're running a mix of synchronous chat (customer-facing chat widgets) and async batch embedding jobs for search re-indexing.
- Expected Q2 volume (conservative): ~120M user-facing tokens/month and ~40M embedding tokens/month. Peak concurrency for chat ~40 concurrent sessions, average qps ~15.
- Our budget range for piloting a production deployment is $8k-6k/month. For a full rollout we could go up to ~$35k/month depending on unit economics.

Questions for pricing:
1) What's a realistic $/1M tokens target for our workload with continuous batching enabled?
2) How much upside on unit economics if we commit to reserved capacity or 6-12mo?
3) Any constraints on latency with continuous batching given our 40 concurrent sessions (target 200-300ms p95)?

Also attached is a simple CSV with our token breakdown. Happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Devon
Director of Product — BrightCart

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Devon Lee <devon@brightcart.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro / demo follow-up

Devon — great notes and thanks for the CSV. Looping Aditya (sales lead) and Marissa (solutions) to confirm numbers and next steps. Quick answers up front: 

- Short answer on $/1M tokens (hosted, with continuous batching & prefix caching): for mixed chat+embedding workloads like yours we typically target $1,800-3,200 per 1M tokens depending on model size, quantization, and batching efficiency.

- For your pilot budget ($8k-6k/mo) we can configure a small Dedicated or high-priority hosted plan to maximize batching impact; expected effective unit cost will skew towards the higher end of that range during pilot due to low absolute volume.

- With a 6-12mo commitment or a reserved capacity contract we can typically reduce unit economics by ~20–35% (depends on model & GPU mix).

On batching & concurrency assumptions (more detail):
- Continuous batching assumption: we assume a steady stream of small requests mixed with occasional larger synchronous requests. Continuous batching yields best savings when average arrival rate is relatively steady and per-request token counts are small (e.g., chat messages 30-120 tokens).
- For your peak concurrency (~40 sessions) and target p95 200-300ms, we recommend:
  * Max batch latency ceiling: 40-60ms (configurable)
  * Target batch size: 16-64 tokens/requests aggregated depending on model; this is done dynamically by the runtime.
  * Expected cost uplift vs naive per-request serving: 2.5x-4x improvement in $/1M tokens with continuous batching + prefix KV caching for chat-style workloads.

Next steps I propose:
1) Aditya to provide a tailored estimate (xlsx) using your CSV inputs with two scenarios: hosted pilot and 12mo reserved capacity.
2) Technical deep-dive with Marissa to validate latency SLOs and concurrency testing plan.
3) If numbers look good, draft a simple mutual action plan for pilot (SLA, trial allowance, checkpoints).

I'll attach a quick pricing estimate. When are you available for a 30-min technical call next week?

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-pricing-estimate-v2.xlsx (xlsx stub: per-model unit economics, reserved vs hosted scenarios)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Devon Lee <devon@brightcart.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro / demo follow-up

Devon — thanks for the numbers. I ran a quick back-of-envelope using your CSV and Camila's assumptions. Highlights: 

- Conservative hosted pilot (no reserved commit):
  * Effective $/1M tokens: ~$2,900 (weighted mix chat + embeddings)
  * Monthly cost estimate at your conservative volumes (~160M tokens total): ~$465/month * 5 = ~$8,000 (note: this is illustrative — the attached workbook has breakdowns by route/model).

- 12mo reserved capacity (small GPU pool, continuous batching tuned):
  * Effective $/1M tokens: ~$1,900 (~35% savings vs hosted pilot)
  * Monthly cost at same volume: ~$3,000-$4,000 (depending on model pinning & quantization)

Key assumptions I used (please validate):
- Chat avg tokens per message = 80; embedding token rate treated as 1 token per embedding unit for cost model.
- Continuous batching efficiency: 3x token-level improvement for chat routes when arrival rate steady; for spiky bursts we model degradation toward 1.5x.
- Latency target: we budget 200ms p95 by keeping batch waiting window <= 60ms and using a low-latency GPU profile.

Open items:
1) Can you confirm typical per-message token size for chat (80 is my placeholder)?
2) Do you expect daily arrival rate to be steady (even distribution) or spiky around business hours? Spiky workloads can reduce batching gains; we model that in the attached workbook.

If you confirm those, I can lock a pilot quote and send a deal sketch for procurement. Happy to hop on a 20-min call with your infra lead if you want to validate latency/throughput assumptions.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
